name: classic
description: Warm, serif, timeless blog theme in the spirit of classic WordPress.
author: GitPress

accentColor.description: Accent color for links and highlights.

showExcerpts.description: Show post descriptions in the post list.

showLogo.description: Show the site logo in the header when one is uploaded.

showAvatar.description: Show the site avatar in the header when one is uploaded.

showTitle.description: Show the site name next to (or below) the logo.

showTagline.description: Show the site description under the title.

showSearch.description: Show a Search link in the header.

showListTime.description: Show hours, minutes and seconds next to the date in post lists.

showPostTime.description: Show hours, minutes and seconds next to the date on the post page.
